title: RiverFront live - Work Lofts, 1 Bedroom, 1 Bath Loft Style

_details.description:
LIVE/WORK! PET FRIENDLY! PRIVATE ROOFTOP!

This gorgeous top floor penthouse in the Biscuit Company Lofts building will be available for lease November 1. Some highlights of this two-story entertainer's paradise:

-Open plan loft style space
-Wolf range and stainless steel appliances
-100% PRIVATE ROOFTOP
-Wood burning fireplace
-Sweeping mountain views
-Natural hardwood floors
-Generous storage space in 2 his-and-hers closets
-High ceilings
-Abundance of natural light

This historic building is known for unrivaled downtown living with its 75 ft saltwater pool, well maintained BBQ/gathering area with Viking grills, designer furniture, 24/7 concierge, newly redesigned lobby, and underground garage parking.

Reserved garage parking space included - EV charging ready.

Long leases preferred.

Renter pays for internet and electricity. No smoking inside the unit.

Newly renovated homes are now available. Located at the juncture of The Arts and Little Tokyo, residents enjoy 20 foot ceilings and easy access to the 5, 10, 101 & 110 freeways as well as a gold line metro stop.

Artisan on 2nd apartments reside at the juncture of the 2 most vibrant districts in Downtown LA, The Arts and Little Tokyo. With some of the largest square footage to be found in DTLA, Artisan on 2nd features newly renovated apartments and lofts with soaring 20 foot ceilings!

Welcome to Unit 424 at the highly sought-after Savoy Community, sitting right on the vibrant border of Little Tokyo and the Arts District. This rarely available top-floor residence has just been beautifully refreshed and features a unique dual-suite layout plus a cozy upstairs loft. Fresh paints throughout, brand-new premium carpet, and brand-new modern vinyl plank flooring. Stunning mosaic tile accent wall paired with a granite food island. Upstairs cozy loft featuring its own fireplace, making it the ultimate flexible space for a quiet home office, media room, or creative studio. Savoy Community offer large swimming pool, relaxing spa, lushly landscaped courtyards, Rooftop deck featuring spectacular DTLA skyline views. Rarely found Side by side parking spaces (295 &296) in P1 area. Unit is unfurnished. Washer & Dryer and a refrigerator are included. NO PET!

Landlord pays HOA fees. 2 Parking spaces, Water and Trash services are included.

Loft in the Arts district in DTLA: nearby galleries, restaurants, bars, coffee shops, hotels, Little Tokyo. Open space loft with very high ceiling (ETA: 24 feet) and wall of glass with natural lighting. The main floor offers a large living and work space, with lots of wall space. Kitchen with stainless appliances. Polished and stained concrete floor. Bathroom with in-unit washer and dryer. 2nd floor is spacious loft style bedroom with custom linen curtains, wood floor, custom mirror. Quiet community in urban lift style
